title: Representation Complexity Along Learning Trajectories: Trading Width for Precision and Time
abstract: arXiv:2610.39027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What computational role does overparameterisation play during learning? Information-plane analyses suggest that neural networks can traverse representations substantially more complex than those required by their final predictors. We explore when this transient complexity serves a computational purpose by comparing the representation complexity needed for prediction with that needed to make an unknown target statistically visible through gradient feedback. We introduce an oracle model of neural network learning and use Kolmogorov \(n\)-widths to quantify effective representation complexity. Our main technical result transfers complexity bounds from the forward representation to the corresponding gradient-query features. Combined with statistical-query lower bounds, this gives a task-agnostic lower bound on the initial effective width required for target-dependent gradient information to become detectable. translated_title: 学习轨迹中的表示复杂性：以宽度换取精度与时间
translated_abstract: 过参数化在学习过程中扮演着怎样的计算角色？信息平面分析表明，神经网络在训练过程中所经过的表示可能远比其最终预测器所需的表示更加复杂。我们通过对比预测所需的表示复杂度与借助梯度反馈使未知目标在统计上可见所需的表示复杂度，来探究这种瞬态复杂性何时具有计算上的意义。我们引入了一个神经网络学习的预言机模型，并使用柯尔莫哥洛夫 \(n\) 宽度来量化有效表示复杂度。我们的主要技术结果将复杂度界限从前向表示传递到相应的梯度查询特征上。结合统计查询下界，这为使依赖于目标的梯度信息变得可检测所需的初始有效宽度提供了一个与任务无关的下界。对于 \(D 维空间中的 \(k\)-稀疏奇偶校验（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出神经网络学习的预言机模型，并用柯尔莫哥洛夫 \(n\) 宽度证明：神经网络在训练初期必须具备足够的有效宽度，才能使依赖于目标的梯度信息在统计上可被检测，从而解释了过参数化在早期学习中以宽度换取精度与时间的计算作用。
